experiences.title: Assistant Professor
experiences.description: Assistant Professor at Aalborg University's Copenhagen campus. My research and teaching activities focus on software engineering and the human aspects of software development.

experiences.title: Vision Paper Presentation—IEEE Conference on Games (CoG) 2026
experiences.description: Presented my vision paper “We Must Be Better”: A Critical Vision for the Convergence of Software Engineering and Human-Computer Interaction in Generative AI-Driven Video Game Development at the IEEE Conference on Games (CoG 2026), a venue that was new to me and turned out to be an amazing and welcoming community. The paper proposes a set of paths that we, as a research community, can follow now that generative AI is making its way into the video game industry, so that software engineering, human-computer interaction, and game design can collaborate toward a better work environment and higher product quality. Photo by Fabio Petrillo—first author of the 2009 survey on problems in game development that is on screen in the picture.
experiences.imageAlt: Stefano Lambiase presenting his vision paper at the IEEE Conference on Games 2026 in Madrid, with a slide about software engineering research on games on screen

experiences.title: EMBO Lab Leadership Course for Group Leaders
experiences.description: Attended the “EMBO Lab Leadership for Group Leaders” course—a four-day intensive training on how to lead a research group, covering leadership styles, communication, feedback, delegation, and team development. Guided by Céline Carret and David Lescheid.
experiences.imageAlt: Group photo of the EMBO Lab Leadership course participants in Leimen, July 2026

experiences.title: Invited Talk—Sustainability Education Week
experiences.description: Invited to give a talk titled “The Double-Edged Sword of Digital Technologies: How AI Shapes Cognitive Load and Well-Being” on the impact of Generative AI on mental wellbeing.

experiences.title: Distinguished Reviewer Award—ICSE-SEET 2024
experiences.description: Received the Distinguished Reviewer Award at the 46th International Conference on Software Engineering—Software Engineering Education and Training (ICSE-SEET 2024).

experiences.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
experiences.description: Postdoctoral Researcher on the project “QUASAR: QUAntum software engineering for Secure, Affordable, and Reliable systems” (grant 2022T2E39C), under the PRIN 2022 MUR program funded by the EU - NGEU. Coordinator: Andrea De Lucia.

experiences.title: EASE 2024 Local Arrangement
experiences.description: Member of the local arrangement committee of the International Conference on Evaluation and Assessment in Software Engineering (EASE 2024).

experiences.title: ISSSE 2024 Organizing Team
experiences.description: Member of the organizing team of the 17th International Summer School on Software Engineering University of Salerno (ISSSE 2024).

experiences.title: Aalborg University Copenhagen—ERASMUS Visiting Period
experiences.description: Visiting student for three months at Aalborg University Copenhagen under the ERASMUS program. Studied the Structural Equation Modelling statistical method and applied it to a research project focusing on the role of individual cultural values in the adoption of large language models for software development purposes.

experiences.title: Mitacs Grant IT43497
experiences.description: Honored with an award for a grant research proposal in Canada supported by Mitacs. The research project is titled “Identifying Critical Success Factors in Video Game Development: A Meta-Analysis Approach”, supervised by Professor Paul Ralph (Dalhousie University) and Professor Fabio Palomba (University of Salerno).

experiences.title: ISSSE 2023 Web Chair and Organizing Team
experiences.description: Web chair of the 16th International Summer School on Software Engineering University of Salerno (ISSSE 2023). Also a member of the Software Engineering Laboratory Salerno team responsible for organizing the school, supporting all social and technical activities.

experiences.title: Copenhagen Symposium on Human-Centered Software Engineering AI
experiences.description: Certificate of attendance to the 1st Copenhagen Symposium on Human-Centered Software Engineering AI, organized by Prof. Daniel Russo.

experiences.title: Best Paper Award at the 25th Euromicro Conference on Software Engineering and Advanced Application
experiences.description: I won the best paper award at SEAA 2022 with the paper titled 'There and Back Again?' On the Influence of Software Community Dispersion Over Productivity.

experiences.title: ICSE 2022 Student Volunteer (Virtual Conference)
experiences.description: I was a student volunteer for the 44th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Software Engineering - ICSE' 22 (virtual).

experiences.title: Social Media and Web Chair of the Third Workshop on Gender Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion in Software Engineering
experiences.description: Member of the GE@ICSE 2022 social media and web chair, an ICSE 2022 workshop about the role, difficulties and opportunities concerning people of different gender in the field of software engineering, in research, education and industry.

experiences.title: Doctor of Philosophy in Computer Science
experiences.location: University of Salerno - Software Engineering Lab (SESA)
experiences.description: Completed my Ph.D. in Computer Science at the University of Salerno (Excellent—Top Grade). Thesis: “Investigating Cultural Dispersion: On the Role of Cultural Aspects in Socio-Technical Activities of Software Development Teams”. Advisor: Filomena Ferrucci. Co-supervisors: Fabio Palomba, Gemma Catolino.

experiences.title: Master's Degree in Computer Science
experiences.description: Obtained the Master's Degree in Computer Science at University of Salerno with a research thesis about Social Aspects of Software Engineering called “Cultural and Geographical Dispersion Impact on Communication and Collaboration of Software Development Teams”.

experiences.title: App Challenge 2021 - VII Edition Participant
experiences.description:

experiences.title: BiblioNet Project Manager

experiences.title: The DARTS Project
